evals.expected_output: Keeps the trivial acknowledgement in chat without generating an HTML file. The response is a simple conversational exchange that does not benefit from a browser-based surface.

assertions.text: Does not generate an HTML file for a trivial conversational exchange.
Responds directly in chat.
Does not mention the activation score or HTML evaluation to the user.

evals.prompt: 帮我对比一下 React、Vue、Svelte 三个框架在性能、生态、学习曲线、团队适配度四个维度的优劣，我要给技术选型会议准备材料。
evals.expected_output: Generates a comprehension-first HTML Decision Board with a comparison matrix, upfront recommendation, and progressive disclosure for detailed evidence. Feedback, if included, is secondary and collapsed rather than the main interface.

assertions.text: Generates HTML output because the task involves multi-dimensional comparison and decision-making.
Uses Decision Board or Evidence Dashboard mode with structured comparison.
Keeps feedback controls secondary or omitted unless the user explicitly asks for formal review.
Shows the answer or recommendation in the opening viewport, not hidden below an ornamental title.
Includes a clickable section index with stable anchor targets when the page has multiple sections.
Provides a chat message with the conclusion and HTML link/path.
Opens the generated HTML in a browser by default, or explicitly reports that browser opening was unavailable.

evals.prompt: 帮我审查一下这个 PDF 的排版效果，我需要逐页标注问题。
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that page-by-page annotation is primarily a review workflow. Uses or routes to reviewable-html-report mechanics for stable page IDs, comments, persistence, and feedback export; html-response may provide a comprehension layer only if needed.

assertions.text: Does not treat page-by-page annotation as a generic comprehension-only HTML task.
Routes to or borrows reviewable-html-report mechanics for formal annotation and feedback export.
Each reviewable element has a stable data-item-id or equivalent traceable page ID.
Supports region or page-level annotation, not just free-text comments.
Feedback export, when requested, preserves review IDs so the next agent turn can map comments to content.

evals.prompt: 帮我生成一个项目状态仪表盘，要有进度条、风险矩阵、本周完成事项。
evals.expected_output: Generates an HTML Evidence Dashboard with visual progress indicators, risk matrix, and completed-items list. Uses semantic HTML, CSS-based visualizations without external CDN dependencies, and respects offline-first default.

assertions.text: Generates HTML with visual progress indicators and risk matrix.
Uses inline CSS for visualizations without requiring external CDN resources.
States 'offline-first' or self-contained without loading external fonts or scripts.
Uses semantic landmarks (header, main, section, nav).
Includes a section index or dashboard navigation when the page has multiple major sections.
Includes keyboard-operable controls with visible focus indicators.

evals.prompt: 你刚才给的 HTML 报告里，风险矩阵那个部分我有两个问题，另外建议操作优先级需要调整。
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a follow-up on an existing reviewable report. Revises the comprehension/priority structure if needed, but uses or routes to reviewable-html-report mechanics for region-specific comments, stable IDs, persistence, and feedback export.

assertions.text: Uses or routes to reviewable-html-report mechanics for section-specific feedback rather than inventing ad hoc controls.
Uses stable data-item-id or equivalent identifiers for traceable feedback.
Exported feedback includes section references so the agent can locate the commented content.
Does not instruct the next agent to send, deploy, or modify data without explicit user authorization.

evals.prompt: 把这份大型相机项目架构分析转成一个真正帮助理解的 HTML。原文包含模块分层、依赖关系、按下快门的运行时路径，以及自动闪光灯、调色盘、夜景、人像、Live Photo 等功能如何跨层协作。不要只把文章切成卡片。
evals.expected_output: Generates a comprehension-first architecture explainer. The opening establishes the core mental model and an overview map; runtime behavior uses a labeled dynamic flow; feature variants use an aligned cross-layer comparison; source details remain traceable through evidence references and an appendix. Review controls are secondary and collapsed by default.

assertions.text: Builds a semantic comprehension model before choosing layout: thesis, entities, labeled relationships, runtime flows, comparisons, evidence, and a coverage ledger.
The opening viewport contains a memorable architecture thesis and a genuine overview visual, not a title followed by prose cards.
Uses a labeled architecture/dependency map where direction, scope, color, and relationship meaning are explicit.
Uses a dynamic or sequence-style visual for at least one runtime story such as shutter-to-save, with numbered or otherwise explicit ordering.
Uses an aligned matrix or lane comparison to show how multiple camera features traverse Settings, Mode, Session, Device, and Media.
Preserves information fidelity through stable source/evidence references and a coverage ledger or appendix that exposes omitted detail.
Includes a clickable section index whose labels name reader questions or lenses, not generic chapter numbers.
Makes exploration controls such as lens switching, highlighting, filtering, or zoom more prominent than feedback controls.
Keeps review and export controls collapsed or visually secondary until the user chooses to review.
Does not repeat one visually identical card and feedback form for every source section.
Passes the 30-second test: a reader can state the governing architecture idea, major layers, and one end-to-end path without opening the appendix.
Opens the generated HTML in a browser by default, or states clearly why browser opening was not completed.

evals.prompt: 把这份很长的技术分析转成 HTML。内容有总览、运行路径、方案对比、风险和证据附录。
evals.expected_output: Generates a long-form comprehension-first HTML page with a clickable section index, stable section IDs, browser opening by default, and a concise chat note that includes the HTML path and opening status.

assertions.text: Generates HTML because the source is long, multi-section, relationship-heavy technical analysis.
Includes a visible section index or lens navigation with `href="#section-id"` links to stable section IDs.
Runs `validate_html.py` with the comprehension or architecture profile before delivery.
Opens the HTML via `scripts/open_browser.py` when the environment supports it, or reports the opening failure.
Does not add review cards, ratings, or persistent feedback controls unless the user asked for review-first interaction.

evals.prompt: agent 已经生成了一个 HTML，结构齐全、TOC 和 evidence appendix 都存在，但首屏 thesis 只是“CLI 导出方案分析”，和标题没有实质差异。
evals.expected_output: Treats the HTML as not ready for delivery until the thesis is rewritten as a conclusion that states the governing model, finding, consequence, or decision-useful claim. Running validate_html.py with the comprehension profile should reject decorative title-like thesis text.

assertions.text: Does not accept a topic label or title repeat as a valid thesis.
Requires the opening thesis to state a conclusion or governing model.
Uses validator feedback or equivalent self-check to repair the HTML before delivery.

evals.prompt: agent 生成的 HTML 把一个 primary claim 标成 omitted，且没有 reason；页面正文仍有漂亮摘要和 evidence appendix，结构校验旧版本会通过。
evals.expected_output: Rejects the HTML until the coverage ledger is repaired: primary items cannot be omitted, every omitted item needs a reason, and each ledger item needs a disposition. The validator should parse coverage-ledger JSON rather than merely checking that the script tag exists.

assertions.text: Parses the machine-readable coverage ledger instead of checking only for its presence.
Rejects omitted primary claims.
Rejects omitted items without a reason.
Requires a disposition for ledger items that represent important claims, relationships, flows, comparisons, risks, or uncertainties.
